title: When Is Muon Optimal? Radial Fragility and Minimax Geometry
abstract: arXiv:2610.21549v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Muon replaces a matrix gradient by an approximate polar factor and has shown strong empirical performance in neural-network training. The Isotropic Curvature Model (ICM) provides a curvature-based explanation for this update by asking when gradient orthogonalization minimizes a one-step local-loss surrogate. We investigate the stability of this explanation when the fixed input radius of the ICM is replaced by a general radial law. We introduce the Random-Radius Isotropic Curvature Model (RR-ICM) and the Polar-Factor Admissibility Set, which encodes exact scaled-polar optimality as a geometric condition on the positive polar factor of the gradient. We derive an exact characterization of this set for arbitrary radial laws and show that all nonscalar admissible responses arise from radial atoms aligned with curvature kinks. Consequently, every atomless radial law exhibits zero-capacity rigidity: exact scaled-polar optimality is possible o

translated_title: Muon何时最优？径向脆弱性与极小极大几何
translated_abstract: Muon优化器通过用近似极化因子替换矩阵梯度，在神经网络训练中展现出强大的实证性能。各向同性曲率模型为这一更新提供了基于曲率的解释，其核心问题是：梯度正交化何时能最小化单步局部损失代理函数。我们研究了当ICM中的固定输入半径被一般径向定律取代时，这一解释的稳定性。我们引入了随机半径各向同性曲率模型（RR-ICM）和极化因子容许集，后者将精确的缩放极化最优性编码为梯度正极化因子上的一个几何条件。我们针对任意径向定律推导出了该容许集的精确刻画，并证明所有非标量的容许响应都源自与曲率扭结对齐的径向原子。因此，每一个无原子径向定律都表现出零容量刚性：精确的缩放极化最优性仅可能在……
tldr: 该论文引入随机半径各向同性曲率模型与极化因子容许集，精确刻画了Muon缩放极化更新在任意径向定律下保持最优的几何条件，证明非标量最优响应仅来自与曲率扭结对齐的径向原子，因而无原子径向定律呈现零容量刚性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Random-Radius Isotropic Curvature Model and the Polar-Factor Admissibility Set to exactly characterize when Muon's scaled-polar update remains optimal under arbitrary radial laws, showing that all nonscalar admissible responses arise from radial atoms aligned with curvature kinks, and hence every atomless radial law exhibits zero-capacity rigidity.
